topic: Rahu Kaal, the daily caution window

instagram.text:
Rahu Kaal is the day’s traditional caution window 🌙 Not a reason to fear the day, just a time to move with a little more awareness.

It shifts by city and weekday, so your window may differ from someone across town or across the world. VedicHour helps you check your local Rahu Kaal, then see how it sits among all 18 planetary hours in plain English.

Your day is not one mood. Some windows feel clearer, some heavier.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.
